scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: High risk of heavy rain in Texas Hill Country, USA on 4 Jul 2025.
why: Rain over 24 h set the level, with 107 mm forecast.
Days with this much rain happen about once every 15 years here now, about as common here as in 1951–1980.
Recent rain adds to the concern: the 6-day total is 144 mm, and that happens about once every 4.3 years here, 3.5 times more common here than in 1951–1980.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 50 km/h), and no snow is forecast.
reply.what_it_means: Avoid underpasses, low roads and riverbanks. Check your official weather warnings, because Groundtruth never replaces them.
